notes: This registers $INAYA's metadata on Wormhole's Token Bridge, the prerequisite before a wrapped $INAYA can be created on any destination chain via WTT. This alone does NOT make a transfer available yet -- the resulting VAA must still be submitted to a destination chain's Token Bridge to create the wrapped token there. See scripts/interop-attest-inaya.mjs and scripts/interop-complete-wrapped-creation.mjs for the next step.

wrappedCreationAttempts.notes: VAA fetch from the Guardian network succeeded (real, live attestation was signed) -- the revert happened in the destination-chain submitAttestation() call itself, cause not yet root-caused. Deployer wallet's Fuji balance was low (~0.0016 AVAX) after this attempt, so further blind retries were stopped rather than risk exhausting it chasing an undiagnosed revert. Next attempt should: (1) fund the deployer wallet further on Fuji, (2) decode the VAA's payload directly to check its encoded target chain ID matches Fuji's Wormhole chain ID exactly, (3) try a different, better-funded destination chain (e.g. Sepolia) first to isolate whether this is Fuji-specific or a general submitAttestation issue.
